_doc: Calibration of the crew simulator (tools/crew_sim/crew_sim.gd): everything it cannot read from the planet's tables, each with how it was found. All times are PLAYER time (robots work in real time; the bot plays about twice as fast as a player). ESTIMATE = taken from the accepted proposal's model, not measured in the game, because the mechanic is not in the game yet.

city_minutes.how: Player minutes spent in each city: the accepted proposal's per-city table (docs/reviews/BALANCE_PROPOSAL_P1_V2.md section 3). ESTIMATE for cities 2 to 6; city 1 is being refitted to the game's walking (M3-21) and may run longer.

hand_parts_per_hex.how: Parts Lumi's own hands bring in per hex of the city cleaned (salvage, wreck stripping, the source job). City 1: measured, about 0.8 a hex (docs/reviews/M3-19_ECONOMY.md). City 2: ESTIMATE, the proposal's wreck city (about 1 a hex by hand plus the source's 90 over 271 hexes). Cities 3 to 6: ESTIMATE, the rest of the proposal's 1,626 Parts not carried by Scroungers, spread over their hexes.

base_level_by_city.how: Base level the player holds through each city. City 1: level 2 is bought near bot minute 11 (M3-21). Later levels cost 1,100 to 1,800 cubes and have no gate past level 3: ESTIMATE that a player buys the level a city's cap needs.

base_level_2_min.how: Player minute of base level 2: bot minute 10 to 12 in the M3-21 runs.

type_open.how: [city index, player minute in that city] at which Lumi has a type's plans. Haul Bug and Scoopie: bot minutes 9 and 17 in the M3-21 runs. The rest: the design spec's unlock order (section 14), one working type per city. ESTIMATE.

mix.how: The default player's build mix: every type the same share, so one robot in six is a Scrounger once all six are open (the proposal's player kept 15% Scroungers).

bench_visit_s.how: Player seconds between bench visits at which Lumi builds one robot by hand: the proposal's city 2 pace (8 to 50 robots in 35 player minutes, a robot every 50 seconds at the bench).

tier_reserve_parts.how: Parts the simulated player keeps when buying a tier step. ESTIMATE.

hex_spacing_m.how: Metres between the middles of neighbouring hexes on the globe (the constant SphereCrew.claim_dirty uses).

path_factor.how: A Scrounger's driven distance over the straight ring distance. Fitted so the simulator's Parts per Scrounger-minute agree with the real crew on a test globe (tests/test_crew_chain.gd).

idle_rescan_s.how: Seconds a Scrounger with nothing to dig waits before looking again.
